name: tool-calling-efficiency
description: N-run tool-calling episodes measuring token cost across tool selection, invocation-input generation, and output consumption, exercised through UTK's real discovery/grammar/cache/mediation code paths.
disclaimer: Synthetic self-authored cases; offline runs invoke no LLM and use a ceil(len/4) token estimate over real code-produced surfaces. Baseline vs UTK comparison happens via `agentv compare` across targets, never inside a grader. Run 1 is expected to carry real schema/template generation overhead; later runs exercise the real .utk cache.
